The 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León was the 33rd edition of the Vuelta a Castilla y León, an annual bike race in Spain. It took place from 20th to 22nd April. The race was part of the 2018 UCI Europe Tour, a series of races that are part of the Union Cycliste Internationale's international competitive cycling calendar. 

The 2018 edition was won by Spaniard rider Ruben Plaza. It was his first victory in this race after he finished second in the 2009 edition. The second place went to Jonathan Hivert from France and third went to Eduard Prades of Spain. 

The race consisted of three stages. The first stage took the riders 182.4 kilometers from Alba de Tormes to Salamanca, the second stage covered a distance of 204.4 kilometers from Valladolid to Palencia, and the third and the final stage was from Segovia to Segovia with a length of 165 kilometers. 

Some of the teams which participated in the event included teams like Burgos-BH, Gazprom-RusVelo, Movistar Team, Astana Pro Team, Caja Rural-Seguros RGA among others.

The points classification, which awards the consistent sprinters, was won by Carlos Barbero who rode for Movistar Team. The mountains classification, which is for the best climbers, was won by Javier Moreno of the Delko Marseille Provence team. Movistar Team won the team classification.
